question: P3, the named gap 'Flat with that gutter at S, M or L was not read', predictions pushed first. A top press at M leaves the gutter mark (CAP-P3VERT-VA, VC); a Vertical press at Custom sets the flat mark (CAP-P3ALIGN2, VB); the flat mark outlives an M press (VB). Here both marks at once: M, top, Custom, bottom, then M and the three Vertical presses, then Custom.
setup: Gestures Probe, unsaved, window 1600 by 1000, a new blank section, its Edit Section panel, named presses only. The run built twice in this capture, Exit Without Saving between.
rule: Ours (as built in #521): flat wins over the gutter until Custom or a field change. At M, top and bottom keep no padding, center keeps M's; at Custom, flat has min-height 0 and no padding; the next Custom press ends flat and the gutter shows on the near edge only (none at center).

predictions.predict: M top: padding as CAP-P3VERT-VA 'A M top' (64 px top, 211.2 px bottom at 1600 by 1000).
Custom 1: min-height 1vh, top padding the 4vw gutter (64 px), bottom 0.2 vmax (3.2 px); as VC.
Flat with the gutter at Custom: flat wins, min-height 0, padding 0 on both edges.
M with both marks, still bottom: flat wins, padding 0 on both edges, M's min-height.
M center's own padding (105.6 px each, as VB 'B M center').
Flat ends; Custom 1 at center: min-height 1vh, 0.1 vmax (1.6 px) each edge, no gutter at center.

scoring: Section min-height and the content wrapper padding (sectionCss), and the pressed Height and Vertical buttons, within 0.5 px. Each case scores only if its two reads agree.
